title: Unlimited Memberships in Past Due Status
content:
**Payments desk note — declined renewals on Marlowe & Finch Unlimited**

A declined renewal moves the membership from active to past due and is retried on the plan's retry days after the first decline, at most the plan's maximum number of retries. While the membership is past due no benefit applies; a covered order placed then pays its shipping fee and is not refunded later. A successful retry restores active status, with the period starting on the original renewal date. After the plan's grace period without success, the membership expires.

### The same rule, condition by condition

| Condition shown on the record | Result |
|---|---|
| The scheduled renewal charge is declined | Status past due; benefits pause; retries are scheduled |
| An order placed while past due on a delivery service the plan covers | The shipping fee is paid and is not refunded later |
| A retry succeeds | Status active; the renewal fee is charged; the new period starts on the original renewal date |
| The grace period passes without a successful retry | Status expired; the closing date is the day after the grace period |

The membership ledger records each declined attempt with its attempt number: 0 for the scheduled charge, then 1, 2 and 3 for the retries.

### Hypothetical timeline (every Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan retries on days 1, 3 and 7 after the first decline, up to 3 retries, with a 7-day grace period)

| Date | Event | Status afterwards |
|---|---|---|
| 1 May (renewal date) | Scheduled charge declined, attempt 0 | Past due |
| 2 May | Retry, attempt 1, declined | Past due |
| 4 May | Retry, attempt 2, succeeds | Active — the new period starts on 1 May |

Had the retry of 4 May and the retry of 8 May (attempt 3) also been declined, the membership would expire after the grace period, with a closing date on the day after the grace period. An order placed on 3 May on a covered delivery service pays its shipping fee in either case, and that fee is not refunded later.
